claim.claim-text: 2. The system of claim 1, further comprising dynamically adjusting via the at least one link engine a threshold for the non-zero link depending in part on at least one query.

3. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one fusion engine is operable to fuse at least one common property and/or at least one common sub-property of the first parameter and the second parameter.

4. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one fusion engine is operable to fuse at least one dissimilar property and/or at least one dissimilar sub-property of the first parameter and the second parameter.
5. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one computer processor is operable to instruct modification of the environment and/or the machine based on the fused data.

6. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one first sensor and/or the at least one second sensor includes an accelerometer, a gyroscope, a force/torque sensor, a proximity sensor, a gear sensor, a magnetic sensor, a humidity sensor, an angle sensor, a temperature sensor, a 6-axis combo inertial sensor, a current sensor, a Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) sensor, radar sensor, ultrasonic sensor, visible spectrum camera, Global Positioning System (GPS) sensor, inertial measurement unit, infrared sensor, depth camera, load sensor, a thermal power sensor, a diode detector, and/or a spectrometer.
7. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one computer processor permanently stores only the fused data.

9. The method of claim 8, wherein the at least one first sensor and/or the at least one second sensor includes an accelerometer, a gyroscope, a force/torque sensor, a proximity sensor, a gear sensor, a magnetic sensor, a humidity sensor, an angle sensor, a temperature sensor, a 6-axis combo inertial sensor, a current sensor, a Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) sensor, radar sensor, ultrasonic sensor, visible spectrum camera, Global Positioning System (GPS) sensor, inertial measurement unit, infrared sensor, depth camera, load sensor, a thermal power sensor, a diode detector, and/or a spectrometer.
10. The method of claim 8, further comprising dynamically adjusting via the at least one link engine a threshold for the non-zero link depending in part on at least one query.
11. The method of claim 8, wherein the at least one computer processor permanently stores only the fused data.

12. The method of claim 8, further comprising fusing via the at least one fusion engine at least one common property and/or at least one common sub-property of the first parameter and the second parameter.

13. The method of claim 8, further comprising fusing via the at least one fusion engine at least one dissimilar property and/or at least one dissimilar sub-property of the first parameter and the second parameter.
14. The method of claim 8, further comprising the at least one computer processor instructing modification of the environment and/or the machine based on the fused data.

16. The system of claim 15, wherein the at least one first sensor and/or the at least one second sensor includes an accelerometer, a gyroscope, a force/torque sensor, a proximity sensor, a gear sensor, a magnetic sensor, a humidity sensor, an angle sensor, a temperature sensor, a 6-axis combo inertial sensor, a current sensor, a Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) sensor, radar sensor, ultrasonic sensor, visible spectrum camera, Global Positioning System (GPS) sensor, inertial measurement unit, infrared sensor, depth camera, load sensor, a thermal power sensor, a diode detector, and/or a spectrometer.
17. The system of claim 15, wherein the at least one computer processor permanently stores only the fused data.
18. The system of claim 15, wherein the at least one computer processor is operable to instruct modification of the environment and/or the machine based on the fused data.
19. The system of claim 15, wherein the at least one property and/or sub-property of the first parameter and the second parameter is the same for the first parameter and the second parameter.
20. The system of claim 15, wherein the at least one property and/or sub-property of the first parameter and the second parameter is different for the first parameter and the second parameter.
